description: Owner-approved student identity decisions for the grid importer. Each resolution says: under this teacher, the name exactly as written in the workbook is this existing student record. Keyed by teacher and name, never by sheet cell, so it survives workbook versions. Only entries with approved_by set are used; the importer re-checks that the student exists and is not deleted. Proposals are generated by `grid_import.py propose` into the git-ignored dry-run folder and copied here only once approved.
